item.title: Video: This Might be the Longest Chairlift Line You’ll See This Year
item.description: Freeskier Cole Claussen, who posted the video and says it was sent to him by a friend, appears to show the excruciating chairlift line on Saturday, December 27.

item.title: City Officials Remove DIY Solution to Missing Eisbach Wave
item.description: The Eisbach river wave suddenly disappeared in October. Surfers attempting to recreate it have been repeatedly thwarted by city officials.

item.title: Pacific Grove, California Shark Attack Victim’s Body Reportedly Found With ‘Shark Band’ on Ankle
item.description: Last week, Erica Fox went missing at Lovers Point in Pacific Grove, California. A week later, her body has finally been found.

item.title: A Tale of Chasing North Atlantic Storm Surf
item.description: The North Atlantic can be a foreboding place. Dark, cold, and big. The author recounts a trip to Scotland, and his own chase for empty surf and a lonely lineup.

item.title: 5 Minutes With Innovative Surf Filmmaker Noah Beschen
item.description: Noah Beschen is part of a new generation that’s taking over the freesurfing world. Not just with his wave riding, but his filmmaking as well.

item.title: Bluebottle Jellyfish Are Invading Australian Beaches Again
item.description: Australia is well known for the variety of ways it can hurt you, and surf lifesavers are sounding the alarm about an inundation of bluebottle jellyfish.

item.title: Telluride Ski Patrollers Union Has Raised $100K in Community Donations to Bridge Work Stoppage
item.description: The Telluride ski patroller's union issued a statement about "outside money," both as a temporary bridge through the labor dispute and as a longterm solution.

item.title: Mark Healey Explains Why He Loves Bow Hunting So Much
item.description: Mark Healey is known in our circle as one of the best big wave surfers ever. He's a lot more than that, though — he's a champion spearfisherman and bow hunter.

item.title: Skier Dies After Falling In Deep Snow Pocket at Banff Resort
item.description: On Monday, Sunshine Village shared a video to social media reporting on the recent snow conditions, saying the Banff resort is "on record watch."

item.title: Five-Year-Old Dies After Arm Trapped in Moving Walkway at Japanese Ski Resort
item.description: A five-year-old boy died after becoming trapped in a moving walkway at the Asari ski resort in Otaru, a city on the Japanese island of Hokkaido.
